code.originalText: Three-month review: blood pressure, lipids on a statin, and smoking cessation

text.paragraph: Three-month review of blood pressure, cholesterol, and smoking cessation. [S]

Mr. Einstein returns about four months after his first visit. He has had no tobacco since his quit date and has had no cravings strong enough to need more than one or two lozenges a day for the past month; he still holds an empty pipe at his desk. His home blood pressure readings average 124/74 on amlodipine 5 mg and losartan 100 mg. He takes atorvastatin 40 mg and aspirin 81 mg without muscle aches, bruising, or bleeding. The back strain six weeks ago settled within ten days, and he has had no abdominal, back, or flank pain since. The lipid panel was not drawn in the first twelve weeks on atorvastatin, because no standing order was placed after the four-week visit; it was drawn today. [S]
